configurePresets.name: windows-clang
configurePresets.description: The clang-cl Visual Studio installs beside cl, under VC/Tools/Llvm: it compiles C++26 and #embed, which cl does not yet. Run from a Developer shell so the Windows SDK and the MSVC library are found.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: The engine as latex.js, latex.wasm and latex.data. Needs EMSDK and VCPKG_ROOT set, and the libraries installed for the wasm32-emscripten triplet: vcpkg install harfbuzz libpng libjpeg-turbo libwebp zlib --triplet wasm32-emscripten
